evidence.summary: The answer states an annual total of 23.4M and average 1.95M, but the source months total 25.4M (average 2.1167M). It calls August the only declining month although February also declines from 1.2M to 1.1M. It says Electronics has the largest absolute regional gap (1.4M), while Clothing is 1.5M. These are substantive factual errors; Q4/December percentages derived from the incorrect total are also wrong.
